producthunt.name: 1752vc Pitch Deck Analyzer
producthunt.tagline: Know what investors will say before you ever hit send.
producthunt.description: The Pitch Deck Analyzer gives you investor-grade feedback in minutes — trained on 25,000+ real decks and the investor decisions that followed. Upload yours and get slide-by-slide fundability feedback — stage-calibrated, checking narrative cohesion and cross-checking your claims for contradictions investors will catch. Know exactly where you lose conviction before you ever hit send. Built by 1752vc, a VC firm evaluating 4,000+ startups a year.

producthunt.name: Topview Motion Studio
producthunt.tagline: Create launch videos without touching After Effects
producthunt.description: Motion Studio helps teams create polished launch videos for apps, hardware, and new products without learning After Effects or hiring a motion design studio. Describe what you want to communicate, upload reference images, and choose a visual style, duration, and aspect ratio. Motion Studio combines AI video models with purpose-built motion design skills to turn your brief into high-quality product storytelling—faster, simpler, and at a fraction of the traditional cost.
